en_title: Learning Curve of Thoracoscopic Nonrobotic Harvest of the Left Internal Mammary Artery in Minimally Invasive Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting
ja_summary: ロボットを使わず汎用胸腔鏡器具で左内胸動脈(LIMA)を胸腔鏡的に採取するEndo-CAB手技を解説し、その習熟曲線(平均採取時間58分)を示す。

en_title: Totally Endoscopic Atrial Septal Defect Repair on Beating Heart: Clinical Outcome and Single-Surgeon Learning Curve Experience
ja_summary: 拍動下完全内視鏡的ASD修復(Hanoi ASD法)の臨床成績と習熟曲線の報告。非冠動脈(先天性ASD)手技でありOPCAB手技ではないため除外。

en_title: Totally Endoscopic Surgery for Repairing Sinus Venosus Atrial Septal Defect Using Double-Patch Technique on Beating Heart
ja_summary: 拍動下完全内視鏡的なsinus venosus ASDのdouble-patch修復手技。非冠動脈の先天性疾患手技でありOPCAB手技ではないため除外。

en_title: Anaortic With No Touch to the Aorta Is a Central Technique to Decrease Invasiveness of CABG
ja_summary: アナオルティック(大動脈no-touch)がCABG低侵襲化の中心的手技であると論じるレター/コメント。手技解説本体ではなく書簡のため除外。

en_title: Reply to: Anaortic With No Touch to the Aorta Is a Central Technique to Decrease Invasiveness of CABG
ja_summary: 上記レターへの著者返信。書簡(reply)であり手技解説ではないため除外。

en_title: Minimally Invasive Coronary Surgery: How Should It Be Defined?
ja_summary: 低侵襲冠動脈手術の定義を問う論説(editorial)。手技解説ではなく概念整理の社説のため除外。

en_title: Robotic Off-Pump Totally Endoscopic Coronary Artery Bypass in Patients With Low Ejection Fraction
ja_summary: 低EF患者に対するロボット支援off-pump TECABの実行可能性と中期成績の後ろ向き臨床アウトカム研究。手技手順の詳細記載に乏しく除外。

en_title: Intermediate-Term Outcomes of Totally Endoscopic Atrial Septal Defect Repair on Beating Heart in Small Children
ja_summary: 小児(13-20kg)に対する拍動下完全内視鏡的ASD修復の中期成績。非冠動脈の先天性疾患手技でありOPCABではないため除外。

en_title: Virtual Reality Simulation for Minimally Invasive Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting With Aortic No-Touch Total Arterial Grafting Technique
ja_summary: CTから3D-VRを構築し、in-situ動脈グラフト(LITA/RITA/胃大網動脈)の必要長と走行を術前に確認してaortic no-touch totalarterial MICS-CABGの設計を行うシミュレーション手技を提示。

en_title: Minimally Invasive Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting in a Patient With Chronic Tracheostoma: Alternative to Reduce Sternal Wound Complication Risk
ja_summary: 慢性気管切開孔を持つ胸骨創感染高リスク症例に対し胸骨正中切開を回避するMICS-CABGを適用した手技症例報告。

en_title: Minimally Invasive Direct Coronary Artery Bypass: An Evolving Paradigm Over the Past 25 Years
ja_summary: 25年・2283例のMIDCABの変遷(開放採取からロボット採取へ)を振り返る後ろ向き臨床アウトカム研究。手技手順の詳述に乏しく除外。

en_title: The 7 Pillars of Multivessel Minimally Invasive Coronary Surgery
ja_summary: 多枝MICS冠動脈手術の7つの要点を論じる論説(editorial)。手技解説本体ではなく社説のため除外。

en_title: Review of Contemporary Techniques for Minimally Invasive Coronary Revascularization
ja_summary: MICS-CABG・TECAB・ハイブリッド冠血行再建という主要3手技を網羅的に解説したレビュー。各手技の現状・適応・障壁を整理した技術的概説。

en_title: Does Intolerance of Single-Lung Ventilation Preclude Robotic Off-Pump Totally Endoscopic Coronary Bypass Surgery?

en_title: Corrigendum to Lung Retraction for Exposure of Lateral Wall Vessels in Off-Pump Bypass Grafting

en_title: Finding the Future: The 10 Commandments of Beating Heart Mitral Valve Repair

en_title: Robotic Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: The Whole 9 Yards

en_title: Reasons for Conversion and Adverse Intraoperative Events in Robotically Enhanced Minimally Invasive Coronary Artery Revascularization

en_title: Benefit of Robotic Beating-Heart Totally Endoscopic Coronary Artery Bypass in Octogenarians

en_title: Graft Patency after Robotically Assisted Coronary Artery Bypass Surgery

en_title: Left Internal Thoracic Artery Graft Assessment by Firefly Fluorescence Imaging for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Direct Coronary Artery Bypass

en_title: Does Robotic Beating Heart Connector Totally Endoscopic Coronary Artery Bypass Bridge the Gender Gap in Coronary Bypass Surgery?

en_title: Does Robotic Beating Heart Connector Totally Endoscopic Coronary Artery Bypass Bridge the Gender Gap in Coronary Bypass Surgery?
